name: TOME Demo
author: TOME contributors
description: A made-up continent that shows what TOME can do: any map, your own marker types (even with your own icons), notes and hints, and progress you check off. Make your own with TOME Studio.

categories.name: Regions
categories.description: Named areas of the map. Tap one to read about it.

categories.name: Fishing Spots
categories.description: A custom marker type with its own icon image, made in TOME Studio.

categories.name: Mines
categories.description: Another custom type with its own icon. Check each one off once you have cleared it.

maps.name: Demo Map 1
maps.description: A made-up continent of tundra, forest, grassland, mountains and desert, with an island off each far corner.
